configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: Development: Ninja, ccache, native tests, fast edit loop
configurePresets.description: Release build with the native tests through ccache (must be on PATH): -O1 test programs and core where results cannot change, precompiled JSON headers, no relink of test programs when only the library's content changed, unmapped source paths so another worktree's build can hit the same cache (the build preset sets base_dir). Never packaged: the packaging and validation scripts refuse it.

configurePresets.name: product
configurePresets.displayName: Product: the options of the build scripts/validate.py packages
configurePresets.description: Release library and Node addon (pass -DNODE_INCLUDE_DIR=...), no tests, no compiler launcher. scripts/package-native.py packages this build. On Windows validate.py also passes -GNinja and the clang-cl compilers.

configurePresets.name: sanitize
configurePresets.displayName: Sanitizers: Clang ASan and UBSan, native tests
configurePresets.description: The AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer build of scripts/check-sanitizers.py (Clang, RelWithDebInfo). Never packaged.

configurePresets.name: sanitize-thread
configurePresets.description: The ThreadSanitizer build of scripts/check-sanitizers.py (Clang, RelWithDebInfo). Never packaged.

configurePresets.name: fuzz
configurePresets.displayName: Fuzzing: Clang libFuzzer target with ASan and UBSan
configurePresets.description: The coverage-guided request and router fuzzer of scripts/check-fuzz.py (target laya-input-fuzzer): the library compiled with libFuzzer coverage (every source, object libraries included) and ASan/UBSan. compile_commands.json lets check-fuzz.py check the instrumentation. Never packaged.

testPresets.name: dev-real
testPresets.displayName: Every registered test (configure with -DDUCKTAPE_TEST_MODEL=... for the real-model tests)
testPresets.description: Serial by default; pass -j N to run in parallel (CPU-time tests stay serial, PROCESSORS counts engine threads). A preset cannot read DUCKTAPE_TEST_JOBS with a default: an empty CTEST_PARALLEL_LEVEL means every CPU.
